name: colCummaxs
title: Cumulative maxima for each column in a matrix

origin.description: Cumulative maxima for each column in a matrix.
origin.usage:
colCummaxs(x, rows = NULL, cols = NULL, dim. = dim(x), ...,
  useNames = TRUE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An NxK matrix or, if dim. is specified, an N * K vector.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: A vector indicating subset of rows to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: A vector indicating subset of columns to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: dim.
arguments.text: An integer vector of length two specifying the dimension of x, also when not a matrix. The argument is named with a period so it does not clash with dim.

arguments.name: useNames
arguments.text: If TRUE (default), names attributes of the result are set, otherwise not.

origin.details: Cumulative maxima for each column in a matrix. The value in row i of a column is the maximum of that column from the first selected row through row i. A missing value makes that cell and every later cell in the column missing.
origin.value: A numeric NxK matrix of the same mode as x, except when x is logical, when the return type is integer.

translation.description: Cumulative maxima for each column in a matrix.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A 2-d array whose axis 0 is rows and axis 1 is columns, matching the printed R matrix. A 1-d vector is accepted when dim is set; it is filled column-major, as R stores a matrix. Logical, integer, and floating values are accepted.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: 1-based row subscripts. None selects every row. The cumulative maximum walks the selected rows in the order given.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: 1-based column subscripts. None selects every column. Zeros are dropped, negatives exclude, and logical values are recycled.

arguments.name: dim
arguments.text: Two integers giving the number of rows and columns. This is dim. in R. None uses the shape of a 2-d x.

arguments.name: use_names
arguments.text: Accepted for the R argument useNames. The result is always a plain array, with no names attached.

translation.details: The walk lives in the Rust crate rowcummaxs, ported from matrixStats src/rowCummaxs.c with byrow FALSE, and the index rules in validateIndices.c. Comparison uses greater-than, so a tie keeps the earlier value. NaN, and the integer value -2147483648, end that column: later rows in the column are missing too.
translation.value: A matrix with one row per selected row and one column per selected column. Logical and integer input return int32. Floating input returns float64.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from matrixstats.rowcummaxs import colCummaxs

x = np.arange(1, 13).reshape((4, 3), order="F")
colCummaxs(x)
